name: submit_training_job CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES failure
description: submit_training_job does not correctly pass CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES to the training process, causing GPU conflicts and OOM
type: feedback
originSessionId: 232e5244-d448-419b-9dd3-45fbb335ed4d
---
Never use `submit_training_job` when specific GPU assignment is required. It fails to propagate `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES` to the actual training process, causing the job to land on cuda:0 regardless of what GPU was specified.

**Why:** On 2026-05-15, inject10-r2 (PID 95247) and inject25 (PID 95170) both OOM'd on cuda:0 because `submit_training_job` didn't pass `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES` correctly, conflicting with the seed123 training already on cuda:0. The original inject10 (PID 94635) worked because it was submitted via manual tmux with `export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2` before the swift command.

**How to apply:** Use `ssh_execute` + manual tmux submission with explicit `export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<N>` before the training command. Format: `tmux new-session -d -s <name> "bash -c 'source conda && export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<N> && swift sft ...'"`. Verify with `nvidia-smi` after 10-15 seconds.
